sections.text: Introduction

This document out lines the detail the major maintenance procedure P1, required for H.P 
mazot pump which must be performed bases on an annually as indicated by Y1 in the 
above title bloke

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by 
quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali Al-Lithy
and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam 
Power Station 2x210MW
Technical specification of these PUMP
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump.
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery
valve.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.

Cleaning fluid,
 Suitable lifting device.

Manual puller, feeler gauge,
 Forcing screw.

sections.text:
Work
to be Carried Out
Disassembly of the pump
Check the closing of the suction, delivery. Heating steam valves.
Let pump cool down to the ambient temp.
Dismount protection against accidental contact from the base plate.

Screw off the bolts connected motor with foundation and moved motor
faraway the pump.

Withdraw couplings half from spindle (12) by using manual puller and
remove key (41).
Prepare tank for catching liquid drain from pump by open plugs (84)&(85).

pump casing (1) and take out gasket (21).

casing (1)

sections.text: Disassembly of the bearing cover and bearing
Remove circlip (35) and spacer bush (16) from the driving spindle (12).

Screw off bolts (54) to dismount bearing cover (5) from pump cover 
drive side (3).

Force off bearing cover (5) from the pump cover drive side (3) and
dismount the driving spindle (12) by using forcing screw and then take out
gasket (22)
Dismount circlip (37) from the bearing cover (5).

Dismount deep groove ball bearing (34) from the bearing cover (5) by
using bearing puller.
Dismount supporting washer (36).

spring plate over the driving spindle (12).
Dismount spacer ring (80) and junk ring (81).

the coupling.
